services.name: Websites
services.short: Business sites, landing pages, portfolios and online stores
includes: Business websites, portfolio sites, landing pages
Online stores and booking or enquiry forms
Built to load fast, read well on a phone and bring enquiries in

faq.q: Can I change the text and photos myself?
faq.a: Yes. We set the site up so you can change your text, prices and photos without calling us.

faq.q: Will it work well on phones?
faq.a: Most of your visitors are on a phone, so we design for the phone first and then the bigger screens.

services.name: Android & iOS apps
services.short: Apps designed to be used, built properly and looked after
includes: Custom Android and iOS apps
Admin dashboards behind them
Products that are easy to use, not just good to look at

faq.q: Do you build for both Android and iOS?
faq.a: Yes. We mainly build in Flutter, so one codebase runs on both and you can launch on both stores together.

faq.q: Can I see the app before you build it?
faq.a: Yes. You click through the designed screens first, and we only start building once you're happy with them.

services.name: Branding & content
services.short: Logos, posters, social media and video
includes: Logo and identity design, brand guidelines
Posters, product creatives and campaign sets
Content calendars, copywriting and account management
Realistic AI videos, reels and video editing

faq.q: Can you make just a logo, or just posters?
faq.a: Yes. Pick what you need: a logo, a set of posters, a month of content or a few videos.

faq.q: Do you make AI videos as well as normal reels?
faq.a: Yes, both: realistic AI videos, and reels we shoot or edit for you.

services.name: Custom CRM & ERP
includes: Custom CRM: lead tracking, sales pipelines, customer records, follow-ups
Custom ERP: operations, inventory, billing, internal workflows
Automation and integration of disconnected tools

faq.q: Can it connect to the tools we already use?
faq.a: Often, yes. Connecting tools that don't talk to each other is part of the job. Tell us what you use and we'll check.

faq.q: Why custom instead of an off-the-shelf CRM?
faq.a: Off-the-shelf tools make you work their way. A custom system follows how your team already works. If an existing tool would suit you better, we'll say so.

services.name: Marketing & ads
services.short: Strategy, Meta ads, ChatGPT ads, leads
includes: Marketing strategy
Meta ads (Facebook and Instagram)
ChatGPT ads
Lead generation
Visibility and reach

faq.q: Do you also make the ads themselves?
faq.a: Yes. The same team makes the posters, creatives and videos, so the ads and the design are planned together.

faq.q: Which platforms do you run ads on?
faq.a: Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and ChatGPT ads. Tell us where your customers are and we'll plan around that.

services.name: Strategy & Student Projects
includes: Digital strategy that ties every service together
Project planning and consulting
Student mini and main project guidance (where we started)

faq.q: Is student project help part of this?
faq.a: Yes, that's where Codifykit started. See the Students page for how it works.

faq.q: What does strategy actually mean here?
faq.a: Working out what you need before anything is built: which pieces, in what order, and how they fit together, so you don't pay for things you won't use.

process.name: Ideate
process.desc: We sit with the problem and find out what you actually need.

process.name: Design
process.desc: We plan the screens, the look and the flow, and check it with you before we build.

process.name: Build
process.desc: We build it properly: clean code, real content, tested on the phones your customers use.

process.name: Launch
process.desc: We put it live, set up tracking, and make sure everything works on day one.

process.name: Grow
process.desc: We run the ads and content, watch what works, and keep improving it with you.

faq.a: It depends on what you need. Tell us about the project and we'll come back with a rough price before anything starts.
That depends on the size of the job. You get a timeline together with the price, before any work starts.

faq.q: Can you do just one part, like only the website?
faq.a: Yes. Pick one service or several. If you need more later, the same team picks it up.

faq.q: What do you need from me to start?
faq.a: A few lines about what you're building and who it's for. A logo, photos or examples you like help, but we can start without them.

faq.q: Do you look after it after launch?
faq.a: Yes, we can keep updating and looking after it once it's live. We agree how that works before launch.
